metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the way home from Shrew, a proclamation at the gate, and the heading on your tables.

yesterday: You came home from Shrew, and then you went to the gate.
The heading is on your tables. It names unlawful assemblies, Greenwich, and this day.
Alone, you said a yard is two thousand people gathered by a flag.
Tomorrow, if you are coming from Shoreditch, you come by Bishopsgate Street.
